about: Second look at a weapon detection (basic_pipelines/garuda_auto/vision_check.py), measured from the Pi 5 on 2026-10-18. Jev jev-1.14.0 (jev-preview) with images; frame and close-up sent, four typed questions. The Hailo was down that day, so the frames are not from live YOLO hits: 15 frames from the three alert clips the service kept (all false alarms: laptop hinge, dark room, blurred close-up), and public Wikimedia Commons images labelled by eye (not kept in the repo).

weapons_10.note: the 3 unclear are old tintype photos and an illustration; real knives and scissors 0.90-0.99

nvidia_scene_models.cosmos-reason2-8b: listed for the account but 404 (not callable)

still_to_measure: live YOLO hits once the Hailo is back (owner's reboot): how many real alerts per day get held
